result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: text truncation in restaurant cards and incomplete content visibility at the bottom of the page.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section. The full restaurant name is cut off and not fully visible to users.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant name cards have sufficient width or implement text truncation with ellipsis (...) that displays the full name on hover, or allow the card to expand to accommodate the full text.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza-related with -20% discount) is cut off at the bottom of the screen. The restaurant name, cuisine type, delivery time, and rating information are not visible, making it impossible to fully view this listing.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all cards have proper spacing and padding so they are fully visible within the viewport. Consider adjusting card height or adding adequate bottom margin to prevent content cutoff.
